title: AgriNexus BRICS Federation Insight
description: Open, minimal schema for a regional node to publish AGGREGATED, anonymized regenerative-agriculture signals to the cooperation network. No individual farmer records ever cross this boundary -- only per-region, per-crop aggregates.

node_id.description: Stable identifier for the reporting regional node, e.g. 'in-mh-01'

dominant_regenerative_practice.description: Most frequently recommended practice across the aggregated sample

sample_size.description: Number of individual advisories aggregated into this record
